name: Moringa Blend
description: Dried moringa leaves hand-harvested from farms in Benin Republic. Clean, grassy, and quietly earthy — a morning cup that does not shout.
brewingInstructions: Steep 1 tsp in 200ml water at 85°C for 4 minutes.

name: Hibiscus & Ginger
description: Sun-dried hibiscus flowers from Benin Republic, blended with dried ginger root. Tart, warming, and good either hot or cold.
ingredients: Dried hibiscus flowers, dried ginger root
brewingInstructions: Steep 1–2 tsp in 200ml boiling water for 5–6 minutes. Add honey to taste.

name: Lemon Verbena & Mint
description: Bright lemon verbena leaves grown in Benin Republic, paired with cool spearmint. Light enough for after dinner, good enough for any time.
ingredients: Dried lemon verbena leaves, dried spearmint
brewingInstructions: Steep 1 tsp in 200ml water at 90°C for 3–4 minutes.

name: Bitter Leaf Tisane
description: A traditional herb from Benin Republic, carefully dried and prepared as a tisane. Distinctive in taste — not for everyone, entirely worth trying.
brewingInstructions: Steep 1 tsp in 200ml boiling water for 4 minutes. Do not over-steep.

name: Garden Green Tea
description: A light, clean green tea. Grassy with a gentle sweetness. Picked young and dried carefully to keep the flavour intact.
brewingInstructions: Steep 1 tsp in 200ml water at 75°C for 2–3 minutes. Do not use boiling water.

name: Deep Earth Black
description: Full-bodied, malty black tea with a long finish. Works well on its own. Works even better with a little milk.
brewingInstructions: Steep 1 tsp in 200ml boiling water for 3–4 minutes.

name: Spiced Chai Blend
description: Black tea base with warm spices: cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and black pepper. Strong enough to hold up to milk.
ingredients: Black tea, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, black pepper, ginger
brewingInstructions: Steep 1–2 tsp in 200ml boiling water for 4–5 minutes. Add warm milk to taste.

name: The Starter Set
description: Four of our most popular teas — moringa, hibiscus & ginger, green, and black — packed in a gift box. A good introduction to what we do.
ingredients: Moringa Blend (8 bags), Hibiscus & Ginger (8 bags), Garden Green (8 bags), Deep Earth Black (8 bags)

name: Herbal Collection Box
description: Six herbal teas from our Benin Republic range, presented in a sturdy gift box. Good for gifting. Good for keeping.

name: Ceramic Tea Mug
description: A wide-mouthed ceramic mug. Holds 350ml. The glaze is warm cream — it looks good on a desk or a kitchen counter.

name: Stainless Loose-Leaf Infuser
description: Fine mesh stainless steel infuser. Fits most mugs and teapots. Easy to clean.

name: Ceramic Teapot — 500ml
description: Single-serve ceramic teapot in a warm off-white glaze. Comes with a built-in strainer.
